PR5 still completes chat boundary plumbing, SMTP, Channels.Api wiring, Channels -> Engine reporting and the grouped-failure modal. Use controlled external adapter-boundary fixtures for unavailable operations while exercising real internal planning/preparation/execution/reporting; verify current packages fail safely where unsupported. Never advertise unsupported production capabilities, guess partial-upload identities, edit ignored deps or substitute local dependency pins. Full provider compatibility must be verified in PR6 before claiming Mattermost attachment readiness. This scope correction does not authorize commits, pushes or dependency publication.

PR5 executes PR4 Channel-local delivery plans through chat/email, reports outcomes through the existing Channels -> Engine path, and groups failed parts in the existing delivery-details modal. Planning is complete enough to begin the prerequisite tasks; feature implementation remains gated by the environment and adapter checks. Application code is unchanged.

## Approved contracts
User approvals in this conversation on 2026-11-27 are authoritative:
- Abort: complete required preparation/uploads before publication; publish sequentially, stop on failure, retain earlier confirmations.
- Continue: keep failed/uncertain evidence, promote the next eligible root with the original answer after an unconfirmed root, then thread later replies under a confirmed root. Possible duplicated answer text after uncertain provider acceptance is accepted. Never retry the failed operation itself.
- Concurrency: ready continue replies use a configurable default limit of four per attempt; threaded replies wait for a confirmed root, independent messages do not. Reports retain plan order, not completion order.
- Deadlines: supervised upload/send/edit steps have configurable default 30,000ms timeout, including sole sends/edits. Timeout/task exit remains unconfirmed; local termination cannot prove provider rejection. No automatic retries.
- Preparation failure: abort publishes nothing; continue uses usable files or text-only original answer if none prepare, retaining failures. Failed files never count as delivered.
- Requirements resolution failure: continue may send text with no file acquisition/uploads while reporting per-attachment configuration failures; abort sends nothing. Use selected connection shared policy and a valid text transport respecting its limits. Optional unresolved byte limits accepted by current resolver are not errors. Planner/resolver remain pure.
- SMTP: measure final encoded MIME and submit that representation; re-encode/recheck changed continuation/thread headers; no automatic SMTP retries. Confirmation is relay acceptance only. Verify current encoder/framing integration rather than blindly copying old version gates.
- History/UX: successful provider messages retain normal transcript behavior. Group only failed parts in one existing per-message delivery-details modal, with uncertainty distinguished from rejection; no separate failed transcript rows or new failure-notice sends. Preserve existing DeliveryConfirmation -> NodeRouter/Event -> Engine confirmation/observation path. Engine owns safe persistence/projection and association to exact answer/input/connector.
- Existing legacy late-failure observations must not downgrade a confirmation. Add typed grouped evidence alongside confirmation, keeping rejected/uncertain/uploaded-only facts distinct internally. Reporting failure must never repeat a provider send.

## Boundaries and reuse
Outgoing has attachments only; Plan stays separate, metadata-only and Channel-local. Reuse PR2 FileSettings/capability_snapshot/TransportRequirements.resolve, PR4 Attachments/Preparation/Materialization, existing bridges/TaskSupervisor, DeliveryConfirmation and Engine History.Delivery/MessageDelivery. No bridge-owned requirements resolver, Outgoing.Delivery wrapper, renamed reporter, duplicate persistence, fabricated support or selection-failure notice path.
Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files at 8d987fa5c supplies scenario evidence; current PR5 restacked base 81629c90a and revised ownership win. Excludes PR6 AttachDocuments/Agent selection and PR7 workflow/notification integration. Proposed runtime is local-only infrastructure, not an agent-exposed Action. Existing NotifyUsers consumes notification behavior and is not a substitute for Channel execution.

Proposed missing work packages:
1. Execution/outcome contracts: define a Channel-local executor input using separate Outgoing, Plan and trusted connection/runtime context; define per-step confirmed/failed/unattempted facts, uploaded-only versus delivered attachment indices, partial results and not-sent versus unconfirmed failures. Preserve stable original indices. Keep raw provider errors private. Reuse Plan/Step and DeliveryConfirmation; do not copy Outgoing.Delivery or selection-stage errors.
2. Shared execution lifecycle: validate dependency graph and references before effects; acquire each original Record at most once per attempt, including cached acquisition failures; reuse Preparation.acquire/3 and Attachments.validate_group/2 / validate_upload_group/2; validate encoded requests; release acquired bytes/prepared payloads when no remaining step needs them. Specify abort/continue behavior separately for preparation, upload and publication. Upload success alone cannot confirm message delivery. Define timeout/task-exit behavior without automatic retries. Confirm concurrency and root-selection rules before implementation.
3. Channels.Api integration: the current :deliver_outgoing handler still calls bridge.send_reply/2 directly. Wire the shared snapshot/resolver, separate plan construction and executor into that existing path, preserving text-only delivery, formatting, canonical answer versus provider body, trusted actor/opts, selected connector and streamed-message identity. Keep API orchestration thin and transport policy in its owning runtime. Do not add the reference report_file_failure/build_failure_plan notice route.
4. Integrated regressions and finalization: real internal API -> bridge -> external transport -> confirmation paths; group failure matrix/property tests; text parity; privacy and concurrent-attempt isolation. Plan owning service documentation, review, post-review coverage and final validation under docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Establish whether any feature E2E belongs here or in PR7; backend integration tests are immediately in scope.
